summary: Iteration 3 — AUTH + RBAC + ownership + loteamentos end-to-end. Backend: 52/52 pytest passing (added TestLoteamentosAndOwnership block with 5 new tests + fixed 3 pre-existing auth-multi tests that assumed free-form property_name / cross-worker state). All critical flows verified: corretor register/login (CPF password), duplicate email 400, wrong password 401, lockout 429 after 5 fails, change-password invalidates old JWT, forgot-password returns identical generic response for registered/unregistered emails, reset-password with bad token 400, Google-session master me, carlos.teste JWT me, owner_id isolation (corretor /sales shows only his, /stats returns vgv_geral company-wide, /ranking is company-wide, cannot PUT/DELETE other's sale → 404), delete creates /history entry with deleted_by_name, /corretores master-only (corretor 403), toggle-active blocks login (403), loteamentos ACL (corretor POST 403, master POST 200), corretor sale with unregistered loteamento → 400, master sale auto-registers new loteamento, master create sale with broker_name=war_name binds owner_id to corretor (Carlos sees it in his /sales). Frontend (Playwright): login page shows email/password/submit + Google button + Cadastre-se + forgot-link; real login as carlos.teste redirects to /dashboard → CorretorDashboard shows 6 KPIs ['VGV Geral (imobiliária)','Minhas Vendas','Meu Volume','Minha Comissão','Já Recebi','A Receber'] with correct Brazilian number formatting; Nova venda opens SaleFormDialog with broker field disabled and value='Carlão' and loteamentos-list datalist present; user menu exposes 'Trocar senha' + 'Sair'. Master flow via injected session_token cookie: /dashboard loads; btn-open-team opens team-dialog with reg-link + copy-reg-link + tabs Corretores/Loteamentos/Historico (all testids verified); Loteamentos tab has lot-input + lot-add; Historico tab lists deleted sales with deleted_by_name.

issues: Recharts logs repeated 'width(-1) and height(-1) ... please check the style of container' console warnings on initial mount — cosmetic, chart renders correctly after reflow. Consider setting a minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer parent to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1177 lines — split into routers (auth, sales, loteamentos, corretores, history, stats) for maintainability.

Historical sales_history collection still shows 'TEST_Broker' leftovers from earlier iterations — add an admin cleanup endpoint or seed script that purges TEST_/QA_ prefixes on startup so history view stays clean for the master.
Corretor dashboard's /sales query returns full owner_id in every row; ensure that field is not needed on the UI, and consider stripping it from the corretor-scoped response for defense-in-depth.

Login response does not expose user_id/role to the client at response-body level in some branches — AuthContext relies on a follow-up /auth/me call, which is fine but adds a round-trip; include the user object in the login response payload to shave latency on first paint.

SaleFormDialog has two inputs with the same data-testid='sale-form-broker-select' (locked variant for corretor + datalist variant for master). While only one renders at a time, Playwright strict mode selectors can fail — give them distinct testids (e.g., sale-form-broker-locked / sale-form-broker-search).

Forgot-password + reset-password token stored as sha256 is correct, but the preview env likely cannot send real email (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY); endpoint correctly returns generic 200 — good. Document in README that in preview the token must be read from logs for manual QA.
Add server-side rate limit (not just 5-fail lockout) on /auth/register to prevent abuse of the public /cadastro link.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full suite: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (52 tests, 2 xdist workers, loadscope). Backend conftest now auto-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — no env export needed. For Playwright master flow, inject session_token cookie (secure, sameSite=None, httpOnly) and navigate to /dashboard; for corretor flow do a real POST login via UI form (login-email/login-password/login-submit). Note duplicate data-testid='sale-form-broker-select' on two mutually-exclusive inputs — use .first() if strict mode trips.
rca of the issue: Pre-existing test failures were test-side only: (1) corretor-sale test used a non-existent property_name while backend correctly enforces the new 400-when-loteamento-not-registered rule; (2) dependent tests across TestIsolation/TestHistoryAndMaster relied on module-level `state` dict but pytest-xdist loadscope schedules each class on a different worker, so cross-class state is empty. Mitigation: tests now (a) read an existing loteamento from GET /api/loteamentos before posting, (b) resolve owner_id via /auth/me instead of shared state, and (c) the delete-history test creates its own sale.
